tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250gshin rje tshe bdag nag po las: shog dril bzhi pa bzhugs:1$0000300 ༁ྃ: ྈ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo: 1$0000250phrin las kyi sngon du 'gro ba rnams spyi ltar btang: dngos gzhi ting gsum 1$0000300rgyu'i e las srog yig rnams 'phros pas 'byung ba rim brtsegs kyi steng du: e las e ka dzā ṭi zil gnon 'khyud: sbyor bas 'od zhu de yi 'phro 'du las: rin chen dur khrod gzhal yas khang pa ni: mchod rten dbyibs can dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: 'khor lo bcu gnyis zla gam e yi klong: pho brang gling dgur dbus su rdo rje'i brag: chu glang zung brgyad ru tra pad nyi'i steng: e las phyag rgya zil gnon sku mdog nag: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus nag spyan dgu bsgrad: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs sma ra ag tshom 'bar: dbu skra thur 'phyang thod skam khrag 'thung lnga: rin chen rtse bran brgyan cing dbu gtsug la: ye shes khyung chen mthing nag 'bar bas brgyan: phyag drug dang pos mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bskor: be con 'bar ba rdo rje gtun shing dang: tha ma gnyis kyis ral gri dgra s+t+wa 'dzin: rdo rje'i go khrab dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs: yum chen be tā li ni smug nag la: snying dang thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud: gnyis med sbyor ba'i 'phro 'du las byung ba'i: phyogs mtshams gling brgyad ru tra brdzis pa'i khrir: shar du phyag na rdo rje mthing nag la: rdo rje dril bu 'dzin cing dur khrod chas: lho ru ya ma rā dza ser nag la: mtshon cha'i 'khor lo thun khrag phyag na bsnams: nub tu ru sbal rngams pa mi zan ni: dug sme mtshon cha'i spu dang mchod rten brgyan: byang du shel gyi mkha' lding dkar po ni: rdo rje'i mchu can spu gri'i gshog pa 'bar: shar lhor lha yi gshed po seng ge'i dbu: lho nub srin po'i gshed chen stag gi dbu: nub byang klu yi gshed chen sbrul gyi dbu:

byang shar gnod sbyin gshed po khyung gi gdong: thams cad rang 'dra'i yum can gri thod 'dzin: zla gam mdun mar klu stong sa bdag khrir: las kyi tshe bdag dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad: khyung gsum seng ge khro bo'i bzhin can la: mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin cing dur khrod chas: g.yon du srog bdag bya rog mgo bcu pa: phyag ni nyi shus mtshon cha sna tshogs 'phen: g.yas su 'chi bdag chu srin sbrul mgo dgu: ral gri nad rkyal thogs shing sbrul mjug can: 'khor lo bcu gnyis rtsibs dbus thams cad la: ya ma rā dza myos byed dmar po dang: ār+ya me ru ral pa tshar dgu rnams: mthing ser dmar ljang ral gri thod khrag 'dzin: rang 'dra'i yum can ru sbal g.yang gzhi gsol: g.yas rtsibs rnams su dung mon seng ge'i mgo: lcags mon stag mgo bswe mon dred kyi mgo: gser mon khyung mgo dkar mthing dmar ser mdog: rang 'dra'i yum can spu gri thod khrag bsnams: rtsibs g.yon rnams su 'chi bdag bzhi po ni: khro bo'i bzhin can be con thod khrag bsnams: srog bdag bzhis 'khyud dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: gru chad nang du thod mkhar bcu gnyis la: zla ba'i 'chi bdag yab yum bcu gnyis rnams: sna tshogs mdog can spu gri khram shing bsnams: khyams la zhag gi 'chi bdag sum cu gnyis: drel glang bya dang dred zhon 'jigs pa'i gzugs: 'obs chen thod mkhar rnams kyi nang du gnas: sgo bzhir dregs pa sde bzhi yum dang bcas: phyi rol mu khyud lcags mkhar drug cu la: gshin rje bdun brgya nyi shu'i tshogs bcas gsal: sku gsung thugs kyi yig 'bru'i 'od zer gyis: rgyal ba'i ye shes bsdus te byin gyis brlabs: spyi bor gnas lngar oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: 'phro 'dus rigs lngar gyur pa'i dbang gi chus: nyon mongs sgrib sbyangs ye shes lnga dbang bskur: thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis: ma gshin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs par 1$0000250bsam:1$0000300

hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings kyi zhing khams nas: bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: thugs dam gnyan po bdag la dgongs: mi mngon dbyings nas gshegs su gsol: lho phyogs gshin rje'i grong khyer nas: 'khor gyi gshed chen gshegs su gsol: srid pa gsum por gnas bcas pa'i: ma mo'i tshogs rnams gshegs su gsol: oṃ mañju shrī ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ hūm̐: mthing nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor du: klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong: dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i gdan steng na: 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs su gsol: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐: e yi klong nas bzhengs pa yi: 'khor 'das phyag rgya zil gyis gnon: ye shes rnam rol lha tshogs la: gnyis med gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: hūm̐: dur khrod rol pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: dgra bgegs thams cad bsgral ba yi: dbang po nang rol dri nga ba: rnam shes khrag dang sha rus zas: rkang gling thod rnga'i sgra rnams ni: dpal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: ma hā puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wid+ya shab+da pū dza ho: hūm̐: dug lnga rnam dag sman chen po: rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar ba'i: rmad byung bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di: dpal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: ma hā pañca a mṛta oṃ āḥhūm̐: 1$0000250mtshan don sbyar zhing dngos grub blang: 1$0000300hūm̐: lcang lor bcas pa'i bhan+dha ru: dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i don snying khrag: dmar chen rba rlabs mkha' la 'phyo: dpal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: ma hā rak+ta pū dza kha hi: hūm̐: bhan+dha 'bar ba'i gtor gzhong du: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor mar sbyar: 'dod yon rnams lngas rab spras pa: dpal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: ma hā ba lin ta khā hi: hūm̐: bde stong gnyis med rab sbyor zhing: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba yi: bam chen gsang ba'i tshogs mchod 'di: dpal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul:

gnyis su med par thim gyur nas: ka dag klong du grol bar shog: ta na ga ṇa ti ra sid+dhi dharma dhā tu pū dza ho: hūm̐: skye med chos dbyings ngang nyid las: ma 'gags longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: mtshan dang dpe byad gzi brjid 'bar: rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: ā: grags stong brjod bral ye shes las: stong gsum 'jig rten rab g.yo zhing: dregs pa can rnams las la 'dud: rdo rje'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: 'khor 'das kun la khyab pa yi: dmigs med ye shes thugs rjer ldan: snying rjes 'gro don mdzad pa yi: rdo rje'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: 'khor gyi ma gshin dregs pa'i tshogs: las la myur zhing bstan pa srung: mthu rtsal nus pa bsam mi khyab: 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo: thugs kar 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas 'khor bar 1$0000250bsams la:1$0000300 oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa: 1$0000250bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bdun: sgrub pa 'bum phrag gsum: sgrub chen la 'bum phrag gcig bzla bar zla gsang nag po'i rgyud las gsungs so: sngags sdeb sogs ni yang gab du gsal: yang sku gsung thugs kyi sngags bzla ba ni: 1$0000300e myags ya rngubs mug shag ka dun: e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya: e dun ka yam:1$0000250 gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi sngags a+yai ring yang bzla: las sngags: 1$0000300ya man dau ru: ṇa yo da ya: sa do me ya: ya k+ṣe ya tsa: ni ra ma ya dgra bo mā ra ya phaṭa:1$0000250 ces bzla: gzhan yang lcags thag gsum dang: stong srog gong 'og: g.yu spyang bcu bzhi sogs las gang dang gang la sbyar ba de bzhin bzla ba gab pa'i shog dril du shes: gzhan phrin las kyi mjug rnams spyi chings ltar bya'o:1$0000300 sa ma ya: rgya:rgya:rgya: ྈྈྈ
